opportunities.name: Rain hybrid artillery
opportunities.objective: Test rain hybrid artillery against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Make It Rain deals 0.6 AP magic damage per second over two seconds and its slow scales with AP; Torch and Liandry reward the sustained zone. Q and R retain AP ratios but physical damage, so magic penetration chiefly supports E and item magic packets.
opportunities.requiredState: Enemy stays in E and long-range poke precedes a safe R.
opportunities.failure: Low AD makes physical Bullet Time disappointing against armor.
opportunities.test: Measure E-only damage and then full R physical damage separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Magic penetration cannot improve physical Bullet Time merely because R has an AP ratio.

opportunities.name: Love Tap cleave tempo
opportunities.objective: Test love tap cleave tempo against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Love Tap adds total-AD physical damage when switching targets and reduces Strut's cooldown; Ravenous Hydra cleave and active support wave-assisted trades. Essence Reaver gives one Spellblade after Q/W while crit supports Q's explicitly crit-capable bounce and R waves.
opportunities.requiredState: Alternate real targets and exploit a killable Q first target.
opportunities.failure: Single isolated target removes Love Tap switching and W refunds.
opportunities.test: Compare alternating-target W uptime and Q bounce damage against an isolated duel.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Cleave hitting another unit does not automatically count as a new Love Tap basic-attack target.

ruledOut.reason: Magic penetration cannot improve physical Bullet Time merely because R has an AP ratio.

unknowns: Controlled current-patch proc testing remains necessary; source helper/statFormula expressions are evidence, not confirmed runtime behavior.

builds.name: Rain hybrid artillery
builds.summary: Test rain hybrid artillery against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test rain hybrid artillery against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Make It Rain deals 0.6 AP magic damage per second over two seconds and its slow scales with AP; Torch and Liandry reward the sustained zone. Q and R retain AP ratios but physical damage, so magic penetration chiefly supports E and item magic packets.
testPlan: Required state: Enemy stays in E and long-range poke precedes a safe R.
Measure E-only damage and then full R physical damage separately.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Low AD makes physical Bullet Time disappointing against armor.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Magic penetration cannot improve physical Bullet Time merely because R has an AP ratio.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Blackfire Torch, Liandry's Torment, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
